name: omp-18.8.0-bun-1.4.2
notes: omp 18.8.0 from its published npm package sources, run by the pinned Bun 1.4.2 (omp 18.8.0 needs Bun >= 1.3.14), so GUI extensions can import vibe/*, collab/* and live/* (a compiled omp binary bundles only package export subpaths). 18.8.0's model catalog knows newer models (e.g. claude-opus-5-5, with its thinking levels). Dependency lifecycle scripts are not run; no source patches.
